Verso upper right corner (printed label in black ink on foam core backing): GEORGIA O'KEEFFE // 1887-1986 // Untitled (Bear Lake) // 1931 // Oil on canvas // 16 1/2 x 36 1/2 inches // Purchase, Museum of New Mexico Foundation // Museum of Fine Arts 84.336 
 
Verso center (printed exhibition label in black ink on foam core backing): McMichael // CANADIAN ART // COLLECTION // D'ART CANADIEN // Exhibition: Carr, O'Keeffe, Kahlo: Places of Their Own // Exhibition Number: 47 Crate Number 31 // Artist: Georgia O'Keeffe // Title & Date: Untitled (Desert Abstraction) (Bear Lake) 1931 // Owner: Museum of New Mexico, Museum of Fine Arts 
(Source: New Mexico Museum of Art, 2025)

credit_line: Gift of the Museum of New Mexico Foundation in honor of the New Mexico Museum of Art's Centennial year, 2017
description: Low orange and brown hills, sloping diagonally across the composition, open up to reveal the dark brown form of a lake at the right of the image. Orange cloud-like forms ripple in the sky overhead.
imageCaption: Courtesy of New Mexico Museum of Art.
